ly take to ship and send a tracking number?
menu
Most in-stock rugs ship within 1 to 3 business days.
Once your order ships, you will receive a confirmation email with your tracking link. Transit usually takes 3 to 7 business days depending on your location.
If you have a custom or special size rug, shipping takes longer: 4 to 6 weeks for rugs up to 7'6" wide, or 12 to 16 weeks for larger sizes.
If you would like me to look up your specific order, just share your order number and email address!
